name: 诅咒结界规则

cardData.damageAmount : 0; var source = battle.pieces.concat(battle.graveyard || []).find(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === cardData.sourcePieceId; }) || target; var result = dealDamage(source, target, damage, "true", battle, "curse-end-turn", true); return { success: true, keepInHand: true, message: "诅咒对" + target.name + "造成了" + result.damage + "点伤害" }; }' }; addCardToHand(cardId, opponent.playerId); } return { success: true, blocked: true, message: piece.name + '的诅咒结界免疫伤害并交给对手1张记录' + damageAmount + '点伤害的诅咒' };
